services.desc: Prepare for 1 hour and 30 minutes of speed and laughter while sliding down our 800-foot tubing lanes. We offer three snow tubing lanes packed with adrenaline and excitement! Available to groups purchasing 20 or more tickets (per day) and who meet below availability requirements will receive a 20% discount on tubing and ice skating. Sessions start every half hour. A max of 40 tickets will be sold per half hour for 90 minute sessions to allow for social distancing. Tickets must be reserved online in advance. services.name: Bike Park
services.desc: We’re excited to partner with TakeAim Cycling as the official mountain bike clinic provider at Bryce Bike Park. TakeAim has been an industry leader in the region for over ten years providing instruction to thousands of riders and certifying PMBIA coaches around the world. At Bryce we are proud of our trails and their accessibility to all skill levels. Progression is the name of the game here and we have something for every rider. With this partnership, we can offer the perfect compliment to the terrain with high quality instruction to match. Please reach out with any questions you have about bike lessons with TakeAim Cycling.
